dialogues.jp:
どこからか、地面を掘るような音が、聞こえて
くる。
なんだか、とてものんびりとした掘り方だ。
また、誰かの夢を見させられるのだろうか？
dialogues.en: I hear the noise of someone digging in the ground.
dialogues.text: I hear the noise of someone digging in the ground.

dialogues.jp: 女の子が砂山を作っていた。

誰もいなくなった公園で、独り黙々と砂山を築
いていく。

目の前の女の子は、萌先輩を幼くしたような感
じの子だった。
dialogues.en: It sounds like someone's digging very slowly.
dialogues.text: It sounds like someone's digging very slowly.

dialogues.en: Am I inside of someone's dream again?
dialogues.text: Am I inside of someone's dream again?

dialogues.jp:
砂山が出来上がると、女の子は手で穴を掘り始
めた。小さな手がゆっくりと動き、穴を掘り進
めていく……。
dialogues.en: A little girl's making a sand mountain.
dialogues.text: A little girl's making a sand mountain.

dialogues.en:
She's making a sand mountain all by herself in the empty
park.
dialogues.text:
She's making a sand mountain all by herself in the empty
park.

dialogues.jp:
少し掘り進めたところで、砂山が崩れ女の子の
手が埋もれる。
dialogues.en: (Is that...... Moe-sempai?)
dialogues.text: (Is that...... Moe-sempai?)

dialogues.speaker: Girl
dialogues.en: The girl in front of me looked like a young Moe-sempai.
dialogues.text: The girl in front of me looked like a young Moe-sempai.

dialogues.jp:
失敗に表情を変えるでもなく、砂に埋もれた手
を引き抜き、再び砂山を作り始める女の子。

楽しげにするでもなく、ただ淡々と手を動かし
ている。
dialogues.en:
When she completed the sand mountain, she started digging
into it with her hand. Her small hand moved slowly as she
dug a tunnel......
dialogues.text:
When she completed the sand mountain, she started digging
into it with her hand. Her small hand moved slowly as she
dug a tunnel......

dialogues.jp: （どうしてひとりでいるんだ？）
dialogues.en: Thud......
dialogues.text: Thud......

dialogues.jp: 女の子は、淡々と砂山に穴を掘り進めている。
dialogues.en:
When she dug a little bit, the sand mountain collapsed and
her hand was covered by the sand.
dialogues.text:
When she dug a little bit, the sand mountain collapsed and
her hand was covered by the sand.

dialogues.en:
Without changing her facial expression, she pulled her hand
out from the sand and started building the sand mountain
again.
dialogues.text:
Without changing her facial expression, she pulled her hand
out from the sand and started building the sand mountain
again.

dialogues.jp:
また、少し掘り進めたところで砂山が崩れ、女
の子の手が砂に埋まる。
dialogues.en: She's just moving her hands, and there's no joy on her face.
dialogues.text: She's just moving her hands, and there's no joy on her face.

dialogues.speaker: Girl
dialogues.en: (Why is she all alone?)
dialogues.text: (Why is she all alone?)

dialogues.jp: 砂の中から手を抜くと、再び砂山を作り始める。
dialogues.en: She continued to build the sand mountain calmly.
dialogues.text: She continued to build the sand mountain calmly.

dialogues.en: Thud......
dialogues.text: Thud......

dialogues.jp: 延々と続く、女の子の作業……。
dialogues.en:
Once again, the mountain collapsed when she was digging a
tunnel, and her hand was covered with sand.
dialogues.text:
Once again, the mountain collapsed when she was digging a
tunnel, and her hand was covered with sand.

dialogues.en:
She pulled her hand out from the sand and started building a
mountain again.
dialogues.text:
She pulled her hand out from the sand and started building a
mountain again.

dialogues.jp: ふと側で人の気配を感じる。

動けない――たぶん透明人間のように立ってい
る俺の横を、女の子と同じくらいの男の子が、
通り過ぎていく。
dialogues.en: She repeated it over and over again.
dialogues.text: She repeated it over and over again.

dialogues.speaker: Girl
dialogues.en: At that moment, I felt someone's existence close to me.
dialogues.text: At that moment, I felt someone's existence close to me.

dialogues.jp: 差し込んだ影に、目線を上げる女の子。
dialogues.en:
I can't move...... As I stood there like an invisible man, a
little boy around the same age as the girl passed by.
dialogues.text:
I can't move...... As I stood there like an invisible man, a
little boy around the same age as the girl passed by.

dialogues.speaker: Kid
dialogues.en: "What are you doing?"
dialogues.text: "What are you doing?"

dialogues.jp:
黙ったまま、戸惑い気味にその男の子を見つめ
ている。
dialogues.en: She looked up as the boy approached her.
dialogues.text: She looked up as the boy approached her.

dialogues.speaker: Girl
dialogues.en: She stared at him quietly with a confused look on her face.
dialogues.text: She stared at him quietly with a confused look on her face.

dialogues.jp: コクン――と女の子が小さく頷く。
dialogues.en: The girl nodded slightly.
dialogues.text: The girl nodded slightly.

dialogues.speaker: Kid
dialogues.en: "Are you here alone?"
dialogues.text: "Are you here alone?"

dialogues.jp: また、小さく頷く女の子。
dialogues.en: She nodded slightly again.
dialogues.text: She nodded slightly again.

dialogues.speaker: Kid
dialogues.en: "Then let's play together."
dialogues.text: "Then let's play together."

dialogues.jp: 女の子は、ちょっと驚いたような顔をして呟く。
dialogues.en: The girl asked with a surprised face.
dialogues.text: The girl asked with a surprised face.

dialogues.speaker: Kid
dialogues.en: "I'll help you dig the tunnel."
dialogues.text: "I'll help you dig the tunnel."

dialogues.jp:
男の子はしゃがみ込み、反対側から砂山に穴を
掘り始める。
dialogues.en:
The boy squatted and started digging the tunnel from the
other side of the sand mountain.
dialogues.text:
The boy squatted and started digging the tunnel from the
other side of the sand mountain.

dialogues.jp: まもなくして、砂山にトンネルが開通する。
dialogues.en: Soon, the tunnel was connected.
dialogues.text: Soon, the tunnel was connected.

dialogues.speaker: Kid
dialogues.en: "There you go."
dialogues.text: "There you go."

dialogues.jp:
あっけなく開いた穴を、きょとんとした眼差し
で、見つめる女の子。
dialogues.en:
With a look of amazement on her face, the girl looked at the
tunnel that was easily connected by the boy.
dialogues.text:
With a look of amazement on her face, the girl looked at the
tunnel that was easily connected by the boy.

dialogues.speaker: Kid
dialogues.en: "Are you always playing in this park?"
dialogues.text: "Are you always playing in this park?"

dialogues.jp: 女の子が黙ったまま、コクリと頷く。
dialogues.en: The girl remained quiet and nodded.
dialogues.text: The girl remained quiet and nodded.

dialogues.speaker: Kid
dialogues.en: "Then we should......"
dialogues.text: "Then we should......"

dialogues.speaker: Kid
dialogues.en: "......again tomorrow."
dialogues.text: "......again tomorrow."

dialogues.jp: 戸惑いの表情で男の子を見上げる。
dialogues.en: She looked up at him with a confused face.
dialogues.text: She looked up at him with a confused face.

dialogues.speaker: Kid
dialogues.jp: 「今日はもう遅いから、帰らないと」
dialogues.en: "It's too late today, so I have to go home."
dialogues.text: "It's too late today, so I have to go home."

dialogues.en: She looked away with a sad face.
dialogues.text: She looked away with a sad face.

dialogues.speaker: Kid
dialogues.jp: 「……の時間に、またここで。約束だよ」
dialogues.en: "I'll see you at...... It's a promise, okay?"
dialogues.text: "I'll see you at...... It's a promise, okay?"

dialogues.speaker: Kid
dialogues.en: "Okay?"
dialogues.text: "Okay?"

dialogues.jp:
コクリと頷く女の子。今までよりもハッキリと
頷いた。
dialogues.en:
The girl nodded. This time she nodded more clearly than
ever.
dialogues.text:
The girl nodded. This time she nodded more clearly than
ever.

dialogues.speaker: Kid
dialogues.en: "See you tomorrow."
dialogues.text: "See you tomorrow."

dialogues.jp: スクッと立ち上がり、砂場から出る男の子。
dialogues.en: The boy stood up and left the sandbox.
dialogues.text: The boy stood up and left the sandbox.

dialogues.speaker: Kid
dialogues.en: "By the way,"
dialogues.text: "By the way,"

dialogues.speaker: Kid
dialogues.en: "What's your name?"
dialogues.text: "What's your name?"

dialogues.jp:
｛ためら／躊躇｝いげな表情で、何か言おうとするように、
唇を微かに震わせる女の子。
dialogues.en:
The girl shivered her lips with a scared look, as if she was
trying to say something.
dialogues.text:
The girl shivered her lips with a scared look, as if she was
trying to say something.

dialogues.speaker: Kid
dialogues.en: "My name is......"
dialogues.text: "My name is......"

dialogues.speaker: Kid
dialogues.en: "What's your name?"
dialogues.text: "What's your name?"

dialogues.jp:
まるでブレーカーが落ちたように、突然、風景
が｛か／掻｝き消える。
dialogues.en:
Suddenly, everything disappeared, as if a circuit breaker
cut off the electricity.
dialogues.text:
Suddenly, everything disappeared, as if a circuit breaker
cut off the electricity.

dialogues.en: ◆Dream 2◆
dialogues.text: ◆Dream 2◆

dialogues.en: I saw a dream.
dialogues.text: I saw a dream.

dialogues.jp:
幼い頃の萌先輩と、そして、知らない男の子が
登場する夢だ……。
dialogues.en:
Young Moe-sempai and an unfamiliar boy were in the
dream......
dialogues.text:
Young Moe-sempai and an unfamiliar boy were in the
dream......
